operations.title: Generic linear marked sections of the four-site del Pezzo boundary are elliptic curves
operations.body: A source denominator is linear in edge variables and cuts a line L in the infinity P2. Its pullback under the quartic double cover is a degree-two cover of P1 branched at four points, hence genus one. Equivalently it is anticanonical. Relative residue therefore contributes rank-two H1(C_g)(-1) coefficient data without any new carrier stratum.
